newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Plane runs over dog, catches fire in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Plane runs over dog, catches fire in Philippines.

text.p: A light plane ran over a dog and caught fire in a bizarre incident in the central Philippines on Thursday but its three occupants were unhurt, officials said.
"It (the dog) just darted across the runway," Catrino Mangoba, manager of the airport in San Jose town on Mindoro island said in a report to Air Transportation Office (ATO) office in Manila.
The twin-engined Beechcraft, operated by A. Soriano Aviation Inc, was about to land when the dog cut across its path.
The plane's right landing gear collapsed, its propeller hit the ground and its right hand engine caught fire, the ATO said.
The pilot and two others were unhurt. The dog was killed.

The state-run ATO runs 85 domestic airports. Its officials have complained about security in some provincial airports saying they lacked fencing. Lack of funds have prevented them from correcting the situation, they said.
There have been several cases in the past of stray animals, including horses, cows, dogs, cats and goats straying into the runways of some airports, drawing complaints from pilots.
